_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
U mothami {player_id} ka Ṋaledi-ḓipheko tsa Liar's Dice le batho ba {num_players}.
Mekgwa:
- Ka nako ya hao, u ka:
  1) Kenya tsebe e ncha ka bongata kapa mofuta o kholo (kapa bobedi) ho feta tsebe e tseng tsena; e.g. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Bitsa tsebe ya pele ka ho ngola '[Call]'.

Uka u bitsa:
  - Uka palo e sa tsebeng ya mofuta oo e feletseng ho tsebeng, mothami wa pele a fela difake tse ling.
  - Kapa uwe, yo bitsang a fela difake tse ling.
Mothami yo a fihlang 0 difaeke o a tsoa. Mothami yo a salang a winna.

board.new_round:
Selemo se secha - Difaeke tse ding: {dice_summary}
Difaeke tsa heno tsa hao ke: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Mothami {current_player_id} a bitsa! Palo e sa tsebeng ya mofuta {face_value} ke {count}, e feletseng ho {quantity}.
Mothami {loser_id} (mothami wa mora) a fela difake tse ling.
call.caller_loses:
Mothami {current_player_id} a bitsa! Palo e sa tsebeng ya mofuta {face_value} ke {count}, e feletseng ho {quantity}.
Mothami {loser_id} (yo bitsang) a fela difake tse ling.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Ho letsetsa ho etsoang ntle le hore motho a beoe pele.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Tsebe e sa tsejohe e le tsebe e halalelang '[Bid: X, Y]' kapa '[Call]'. Tsebe e rometsoeng: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Palo e ncha {new_quantity} ke tlase ho feta ea hona joale {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Boleng bo bocha ba nomoro {new_face_value} ke tlaase ho feta hona joale {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Tefiso e tšoana le tefo ea hona joale.
bid_reason.face_range: Boleng ba eona bo lokela ho tloha 1 ho ea 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Sebapali {player_id} se ile sa tlosoa ka ho tsamaea ha sona.

outcome.win: Mothami {winner} a winna! Thebo ya mora: {final_ranking}
